claims.assertion: Arishah says Urmah follow only logical Federation rules, preserve autonomy, and maintain a feline federation the Federation avoids challenging.
claims.speaker: Arishah (interviewee; translated by Mari Swaruu)

claims.assertion: He alleges the Federation guided a Centauri civilizational reset and fabricated reptilian-invasion stories, while accepting exploitation may have occurred.
claims.speaker: Arishah (interviewee; translated by Mari Swaruu)

claims.assertion: Arishah says Urmah are at peace with Alpha Dracos and use military strength to deter aggressive species from their region.
claims.speaker: Arishah (interviewee; translated by Mari Swaruu)

claims.assertion: Arishah opposes the Federation’s handling of Earth, alleging it manipulates the desires it claims to protect.
